findings.fsdQuote: Each row on the Home screen can be collapsed, and Kavita remembers the choice on the next visit.
findings.note: The dashboard and carousel components have no collapse behaviour or remembered collapsed state.

findings.fsdQuote: A Random button on the library screen opens a randomly chosen series from that library.
findings.note: No Random button or random-series action exists on the library screen.

findings.fsdQuote: Manga series open on the Volumes tab by default.
findings.note: For manga (and non-comic, non-book) libraries the default tab is Storyline, not Volumes; only book/light novel libraries default to Volumes.

findings.fsdQuote: Brightness can be set anywhere from 0% to 100%.
findings.note: The brightness field is validated with a minimum of 10 and a maximum of 100.

findings.fsdQuote: Font size can be set from 50% to 200%.
findings.note: Reading profile validation allows book reader font size from 50 to 300.

findings.fsdQuote: Kavita removes a series from Want to Read automatically as soon as the user finishes reading it.
findings.note: Removal is a scheduled cleanup task, and only for series that are Completed or Cancelled and 100% read; it is not immediate on finishing.

findings.fsdQuote: The series in a collection can be exported to a CSV file.
findings.note: No export or CSV feature exists in the collections UI.

findings.fsdQuote: A filter box for finding items appears once a list has more than 25 items.
findings.note: The filter box appears when the list has more than 10 items.

findings.fsdQuote: The owner can share a reading list through a public link that opens without signing in.
findings.note: No public share link or share token feature exists for reading lists.
A Genres browse screen lists genres with series and issue counts; the FSD describes only People and Tags.
An All Annotations browse screen exists but is not described in the FSD.

findings.fsdQuote: A new password must be at least 8 characters long.
findings.note: The identity password option requires a length of 6.

findings.fsdQuote: When Prompt on Download is on, Kavita asks for confirmation before any download larger than 500 MB.
findings.note: The size warning threshold is 100 MB (104857600 bytes).

findings.fsdQuote: Changes on this page are stored only when the administrator presses Save.
findings.note: Settings are auto-saved after a 300 ms debounce whenever the form is valid; there is no Save button.

findings.fsdQuote: A maintenance mode switch blocks all non-admin users from signing in until it is turned off.
findings.note: No maintenance mode setting exists; the only 'maintenance' in the server code is the nightly maintenance task.

findings.fsdQuote: An invite can be given an expiry date, after which its link stops working.
findings.note: The invite form holds only email, libraries, roles and age restriction; there is no expiry field.

findings.fsdQuote: Manage Collections is turned on by default for a new library.
findings.note: The add-library form defaults manageCollections to false (the entity default is true but the form overrides it).
